artifacts.description: JUnit report of the S10 test run (ignored; kept by hash)
the real records of wilson-ig-v1 (spec §9.3-9.5, §17 A4-3)
the fit claims and fit quality (not validation)
the real section: E-, F- and I-state expectations (spec §9.7, §16)

the S10 specification the checks are read from (§0, §7.5, §14-§19)

limitations: §0: **Nothing about a real mixture follows from the verification.** It runs on three invented components (`VA`, `VB`, `VC`; §6). It shows that an implementation computes the closed forms of §3–§5. It says nothing about methanol, ethanol or water.
§0: **Agreement with IDAES or DWSIM (§8) is numerical verification of the same equations, not validation.** The two tools receive our parameters. An error shared by the matched inputs passes.
§0: **Fit quality is not validation** (§9.4). The Wilson parameters are fitted to binary data. Agreement with those data is reported as fit quality and never as validation.
§0: **The validation bands (§9.6) are fitness statements on the held-out datasets only.** Inside a band the claim is still limited to those datasets' T, P and composition ranges.
§0: **The stability label is global only within the model** (§4): one Wilson liquid and one ideal-gas vapour. It does *not* establish that the real mixture has no second liquid phase.
§0: **No column, PH-flash or flowsheet claim.** The column's refusal S11 (`wp/S03`) is unchanged by S10 (§10).
§0: **No claim on rights.** §9.1 lists the rights rows and their status. Nothing ships on this document's authority.

§0: **Excluded:** LLE, electrolytes, high pressure (P > 2 × 10⁵ Pa), excess enthalpy, liquid volume and transport properties. So is derivative-based optimisation across a phase boundary (blueprint §6.3).

§15 A2-6 (as written at Amendment 2): **The global claim is relative to the grid.** No point of the step-0.005 grid lies below Φ* − 10⁻¹². A minimum in a valley narrower than the grid spacing is not excluded.

§15 A2-6 (as written at Amendment 2): (**Replaced by §17 A4-2 item 3:** not determined by Table II; up to 0.46 K in ternary predictions.) **The individual Λ of methanol + ethanol are weakly determined.** The sum θ_12 + θ_21 is well determined, and the difference is not (finding 2). The records carry the least-squares point and claim no parameter uncertainty. Do not read physical meaning into Λ_ME or Λ_EM individually.
§15 A2-6 (as written at Amendment 2): **Fit quality is not validation.** Validation is §9.6's.
§15 A2-6 (as written at Amendment 2): **The IDAES comparison covers no near-azeotrope state**, now that I10 has moved out of that region.
§15 A2-6 (as written at Amendment 2): **A2-4 is not a legal opinion.** Shipping is Frank's decision.
§15 A2-6 (as written at Amendment 2): **The synthetic verification set is not touched.**
§16 A3-9 (as written at Amendment 3): **Agreement with IDAES.** No comparison has been computed, and nothing here predicts A41's outcome.
§16 A3-9 (as written at Amendment 3): **That every floor stall converges at 10⁻⁹.** The floor derivation explains the stalls. WO-S10-4b decides.
§16 A3-9 (as written at Amendment 3): **A rung-dependence check for a state converged at one rung.** There is none.

§16 A3-9 (as written at Amendment 3): **Anything about our flash or the states from IDAES's initializer failures** (I3 and I11, and others at some rungs). (**Corrected by §17 A4-1:** I11 converges at 10⁻⁴ with MA27.) They are a property of IDAES 2.13's initializer from this start.

§16 A3-9 (as written at Amendment 3): **That the generator's T_dew^I equals IDAES's.** It equals it only to within the flash agreement. It is used for margins and predictions, and it is never compared.
§16 A3-9 (as written at Amendment 3): **The theorem of A3-3 for any version but IDAES 2.13.0.** It holds for that version's equations as read; A44 guards the reading.
§16 A3-9 (as written at Amendment 3): **A rigorous bound in CVT-EFFECT.** It is a first-order, row-wise estimate with a margin of 10³.

§16 A3-9 (as written at Amendment 3): **That DWSIM's flash agrees with ours at 10⁻⁷.** DWSIM's readbacks verify the model functions. Its flash is limited by its own 10⁻⁶ stop, and β, x, y, K and h are not compared at two-phase states.
§16 A3-9 (as written at Amendment 3): **Validation.** Agreement with either tool would be numerical verification by an independent implementation (D19), not empirical validation (§9.6).
§17 A4-5: **Any change to a selection, classification, verdict or band.** I11 was already compared, and A44 was already judged on the verbose rendering.
§17 A4-5: **That the methanol + ethanol Λ are wrong.** They are the registered least-squares point. A4-2 shows that they are not identifiable from Table II, and it says what that does to predictions.
§17 A4-5: **VAL-2.** It remains untested.
§17 A4-5: **A legal reading of any rights row**, or permission to ship. Q-F3 stays Frank's.

§18 A5-7: **Any rights verdict, or that the records may ship.** T08.A32 checks that a rights statement exists and that the values are their sources'. RC-05, RC-06 and RC-08 stay unresolved, and Q-F3 stays Frank's.
§18 A5-7: **That the Λ are vetted by T08.A32.** They are S10.A31's and A33's.
§18 A5-7: **That the stored fit is the best or the unique one.** The vetting checks its claim against the source points.
§18 A5-7: **aarch64's actual floor.** It is bounded by 2A, measured by the next CI run (Q-A5.1), and not yet observed beyond item 2.
§18 A5-7: **That water's two molar masses or two formation enthalpies are reconciled** (Q-A5.2, R-704).
§18 A5-7: **That D19 is met.**
§18 A5-7: **Anything about M01's or L01's records** beyond their unchanged checks.
§19 A6-13: **Any VAL-2 result.** Nothing has been computed on the 1995 data.
§19 A6-13: **That the 1995 data are right, or that the transcription is.** Double entry shows that two independent entries agree, one of them made from the page image. It does not check the paper.

§19 A6-13: **A pressure domain below 30 kPa.** VAL-2 computes model bubble pressures there through (3.10). A result within band would be a fitness statement at those points. `describe().domain` is unchanged (Q-A6.3).
§19 A6-13: **Constant-Λ extrapolation outside 323.15–333.15 K, for the methanol + ethanol pair, or for the ternary.** VAL-2 has no data on the last two.

§19 A6-13: **That the paper's pressure scale equals the project's.** The paper's pressures rest on Bridgeman and Aldrich's (1964) vapour pressures of water. The project's water P^sat is fitted to IAPWS-95 through CoolProp. A difference between the two enters every ΔP/P as a common factor. It is not corrected, since that would need the 1964 table and a choice of interpolation, and it is not measured here.
§19 A6-13: **A rights verdict,** or permission to ship. RC-06 stays unresolved, and Q-F3 stays Frank's.
